normalization.highCritical: any native tool-definition HIGH/CRITICAL non-advisory finding
normalization.advisoryOnly: one or more definition signals with no HIGH/CRITICAL non-advisory finding; includes medium/low/info/advisory
excludedWardenPolicy: pinning/origin/sandbox/explicit command policy, retained in raw native records
normalization.auditCore: all native runtime/tool/delegation/annotation findings; launch/config hygiene retained separately
normalization.coldLock: Truecopy unpinned refusal is enforcement policy, not definition detection
